policies.name: Save Our Seas 2.0 Act
policies.summary: Funds marine debris cleanup, expands recycling infrastructure grants, and asks NOAA to coordinate plastic research.

policies.name: California SB 54 — Plastic Pollution Prevention and Packaging Producer Responsibility Act
policies.summary: Requires 100% of single-use packaging in California to be recyclable or compostable by 2032 and shifts cost onto producers.

newsFeed.headline: Less than 9% of U.S. plastic gets recycled, EPA confirms
newsFeed.summary: An updated EPA accounting found that despite curbside collection, fewer than 1 in 10 plastic items in the U.S. is actually remade into something new.

wooby.headline: The U.S. uses a lot of plastic — but only a tiny bit gets recycled.
wooby.narrative: Wooby has seen plastic bottles from American beaches drift all the way to the open Pacific. Most U.S. plastic is buried, burned, or floats away. A few states like California are starting to make rules. Wooby is hopeful but waiting.
